ui_mockups.title: AR Treasure Hunt Interface
ui_mockups.description: Augmented Reality interface showing the treasure hunting experience. Features a camera view overlay with AR elements, treasure detection indicators, and pirate-themed UI components. Includes capture buttons and distance indicators for immersive treasure hunting gameplay.
ui_mockups.context: This mockup demonstrates the core AR functionality where players use their device camera to locate and capture virtual treasures in real-world environments.

ui_mockups.title: Pirate Leaderboard Interface
ui_mockups.description: Leaderboard screen displaying top pirates ranked by treasures captured. Features a pirate-themed design with player rankings, treasure counts, and pirate ranks/titles. Includes navigation elements and social competition features.
ui_mockups.context: This interface encourages competitive gameplay by showing how players rank against others in their treasure hunting achievements.

ui_mockups.title: Pirate Login Portal
ui_mockups.description: Authentication interface with pirate-themed design for user login. Features email/password input fields, pirate imagery, and smooth animations. Includes options for new user registration and password recovery within the treasure hunting theme.
ui_mockups.context: The entry point for pirates to access their treasure hunting adventures, maintaining the pirate aesthetic while providing secure authentication.

ui_mockups.title: Treasure Map Interface
ui_mockups.description: Interactive map displaying real-world locations with treasure markers, player positions, and other pirates. Features pirate-styled map elements, treasure indicators, and navigation controls. Includes zoom functionality and real-time player tracking.
ui_mockups.context: The main navigation interface where players explore their surroundings to locate treasures and see other active pirates in the area.

ui_mockups.title: Team/Profile Interface
ui_mockups.description: Team or profile management interface showing pirate crew information, player statistics, and social features. Includes avatar displays, achievement badges, and team collaboration tools within the pirate adventure theme.
ui_mockups.context: Social interface for managing pirate crews, viewing achievements, and collaborating with other players in treasure hunting expeditions.
